mechanism.cause: The v1.4 wrapper called configure(BUILD) directly and the inherited PRODUCT.main entrypoint called the same one-shot configuration again. The second require-resolver selector therefore saw the already-selected 166-byte CALLPRIM profile instead of its 164-byte predecessor and failed closed.
mechanism.failed_boundary: wrapper startup before product build directory creation
mechanism.permanent_closer: The candidate startup gate forbids a direct configure call and requires exactly one PRODUCT.configure binding for the inherited entrypoint. Its double-configure mutation must fail.

claim_limit: Host startup First Red only. No product, linker, geometry, media, device, Link-92 or release claim.
